title: Word Problems
subject: Mathematics
description: Math stories! Find the clues and solve them.

video.title: Real World Addition & Subtraction Word Problems

steps: A word problem is a math story. Read it slowly — maybe twice!
Find the numbers and the question: what do we need to find out?
Clue words: 'altogether', 'in all', 'total' usually mean ADD. 'Left', 'fewer', 'gave away' usually mean SUBTRACT.
Solve, then ask: does my answer make sense?

questions.prompt: 'Altogether' and 'in all' usually mean you should...
Keisha has 12 stickers. She gives 4 to her friend. How many are LEFT?
Tom picked 9 mangoes and Ann picked 7. How many altogether?
There are 15 birds. 6 fly away. How many are left?
